  APPLICATION OF SOUTHWESTERN ELECTRIC POWER
  COMPANY FOR AUTHORITY TO AMEND TARIFFS FOR
RETAIL ELECTRIC SERVICE TO INCLUDE NEW STANDARD
FORM CONTRACT FOR ELECTRIC SERVICE – LARGE LOAD




                            SOAH ORDER NO. 9
                       CANCELLING HEARING ON MERITS

         On August 11, 2026, Southwestern Electric Power Company filed an agreed
motion to cancel the hearing on the merits scheduled for August 12, 2026, and have
the case decided via briefing. The motion is GRANTED.


         As stated in SOAH Order No. 5, post-hearing briefs are due on the following
dates:
         • August 27, 2026: Initial Briefs, and
          • September 4, 2026: Reply Briefs, along with proposed findings of fact and
             conclusions of law.1



Signed August 11, 2026



                                                   _____________________________
                                                   Rachelle Nicolette Robles,
                                                   Administrative Law Judge




1 The latter requirement was not included in the procedural schedule in SOAH Order No. 5, but the Administrative

Law Judge adds it with this order.
